claims.claim: Pharaon returns to Marseilles; Leclere died at sea
claims.evidence: 'Off Civita Vecchia we lost our brave Captain Leclere'
'he assumed the command' / Morrel: 'that was his duty as captain's mate'

claims.claim: greeted by owner Morrel; Danglars supercargo resents him
claims.evidence: 'here is your supercargo, M. Danglars'; 'Danglars did not lose one pang that Fernand endured'

claims.claim: about to be captain and marry Mercédès
claims.evidence: 'Is it really your intention to make me captain of the Pharaon?'; 'the lovely Mercédès'

claims.claim: denounced as Bonapartist by Danglars and Fernand
claims.evidence: 'I will denounce him!' ; 'agent of the Bonapartist faction'

claims.claim: Villefort buries case to protect father
claims.evidence: 'Oh, my father, must your past career always interfere' ; burns the letter

claims.claim: Abbé Faria teaches him, tells of treasure on Monte Cristo
claims.evidence: Faria, Cardinal Spada's secretary; Ch.18 The Treasure
'It was fourteen years, day for day, since Dantès' arrest'

claims.claim: Fernand, Count de Morcerf, exposed, kills himself
claims.evidence: 'The general has just blown his brains out'; Ch. 92 The Suicide
Ch. 115 captured by Vampa's bandits, 'Keep the 50,000 francs' left to him
Ch.109-111; wife and child dead, 'Oh, he is mad!'; 'one is mad, the other dead'

claims.claim: unites Valentine with Maximilian; 'Wait and hope'
Maximilian Morrel son of Dantès's old employer; loves Valentine
